instruction: Compare Apple Watch Series 9 with Apple Watch Ultra 2 and Apple Watch SE

metadata.explanation: Variation comparing Apple Watch models using the same Apple comparison interface. The agent needs to navigate to the Apple Watch comparison page and select the three specified models: Apple Watch Series 9, Apple Watch Ultra 2, and Apple Watch SE. Uses existing evaluator that parses the modelList parameter from the active tab URL.
metadata.verification: The expected modelList values match Apple's URL parameter format for Apple Watch models. Similar to the original iPhone comparison task, maintaining similar complexity and interaction pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_tab_url_parse properly extracts URL query parameters from the active Chrome tab using accessibility tree and urlparse
Expected values are semantically correct: The modelList values ('apple-watch-series-9', 'apple-watch-ultra-2', 'apple-watch-se') match Apple's standard URL parameter format for product comparisons
Metric logic is correct: check_direct_json_object properly compares the extracted modelList with expected values, supporting ignore_list_order to allow any ordering of the three models
Coverage is complete: The evaluator verifies all three Apple Watch models specified in the instruction are present in the comparison URL
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts {modelList: [models]} from URL -> Metric compares with expected list -> Returns 1.0 only if all three models match (order-independent)
Edge cases handled: Missing URL parameters return None (fails evaluation), different model orderings are handled via ignore_list_order flag
